title: Aggregator x Byzantine Attack Comparison
metric_interpretation_note: byzantine_tpr / honest_fpr are only non-trivially meaningful for the Krum-family aggregators (multi_krum, adaptive_krum, calibrated_krum), which make an explicit per-client accept/reject decision (krum_selected / krum_detected_byzantine columns in results_*.csv). fedavg, median, and trimmed_mean never reject a client -- they aggregate everyone (median/trimmed_mean do so robustly, fedavg does not) -- so their TPR/FPR will read exactly 0%/0% BY CONSTRUCTION, not because the attack went undetected. This is a correct result, not a bug, and must be stated explicitly wherever Table 2 is written up: for those three aggregators, robustness shows up in Macro-F1 and Attack Success Rate degradation, not in TPR/FPR.
